dates.built: 1642 to 1759 among the houses read here
dates.note: The German Wikipedia list of Simmental farmhouses gives dated houses from 1642 (Nidfluh Nr. 309, Därstetten) through 1655, 1705, 1738, 1751, 1756 and 1759. The node's exemplar note says '17th-18th century', which those dates support.

quotes.text: Die ältesten Häuser aus der Zeit um 1500 zeigen das spätmittelalterliche Konstruktionselement des «Heidenkreuzes» an der Fassade. Der mit wuchtigen Fusshölzern verstrebte Firstpfosten diente der Versteifung der Giebelwand. Baumeister vieler ausgezeichneter Bauernhäuser sind Hans Messerli und seine beiden Söhne.

note:
Tranche 3, Alpine cluster, 5 September 2026. A GROUP record and declared as one, because the node's exemplar names a museum and a region in one string and cannot be resolved to a building. WHAT THE SOURCE ADDS TO THE NODE is a piece of structure the node's prose does not mention at all: the oldest Simmental fronts carry a «Heidenkreuz», a ridge post braced with heavy foot timbers to stiffen the gable wall. The node explains the gable face entirely in terms of the eave overhang and its ornament -- carved bargeboard, Lauben, inscription band, shaped purlin ends -- and here is a structural member doing the gable's real work.

The Knuttihaus row is quoted rather than paraphrased because this tranche also gives that house its own record, and the two must agree.
